overview: Heavy day for Musk-world: Tesla posted Q3 numbers and SpaceX closed a record week that included Starship's first orbital flight. In AI, OpenAI's Sam Altman addressed Cerebras speculation, Coinbase opened agent trading, and Google launched a TPU satellite prototype. On markets, a Burry-tracking account flagged a 5.34% 10-year Treasury yield and 7.28% mortgage rates.
